scraped.title: Study: iStart Career Programme for international students
scraped.subtitle: iStart wissenschaftliche Begleit- und Wirkungsanalyse
scraped.financing: Ministerium für Kultur und Wissenschaft NRW
scraped.description: The University of Bonn offers the iStart career program for international students as part of the “NRWege Leuchttürme” grant program. iStart teaches participants tangible knowledge and valuable skills to facilitate their entry in the German labor market. Next to open advisory…
body: The University of Bonn offers the iStart career program for international students as part of the “NRWege Leuchttürme” grant program. iStart teaches participants tangible knowledge and valuable skills to facilitate their entry in the German labor market. Next to open advisory services, an Intensive Career Program is offered every semester. Selected students can choose to participate in courses from three general blocks: • Orientation: participants learn about the German job market and how to create their career profile with expert lectures, group and individual coaching sessions.
Networking: participants can connect with international university graduates and local companies and improve their networking skills.
Application: participants learn how to prepare for applications in lectures, expert talks, mock-interviews and with application documents reviewed in a one-to-one coaching session.

The accompanying study was a mid-term, mixed-methods evaluation with the goal to evaluate short- and long-term impact on employability and identify possible areas improvement. Quantitative analysis used existing M&E data with data gathered at three points in time for each cohort. Due to attrition, meaningful statistical impact analysis was not feasible. An extensive descriptive analysis of cross-sectional data was supplemented with key informant interviews and focus group discussions with former participants as well as a desk review. The study's key characteristics are:
Theory-based approach with contribution analysis
Construction of a working theory of change based on the CareerEDGE model
Key informant interviews and focus group discussions
Descriptive analysis of cross-sectional data in R
Quantitative and qualitative reports as well as final report triangulating all sources
Final presentation of results at multi-stakeholder meeting
Formulation of actionable recommendations
